To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dielectric and conduction parameters of In4Se3S3 and In4Se3.5S3.5 are studied.
the ac conduction mechanism in the In4Se96−xSx system is correlated barrier hopping (CHB) and the maximum barrier height W m is 0.32 eV.
the ac conduction in In4Se96Sx semiconductor is governed by the correlated barrier hopping model and the effect of sulfur is observed on dielectric parameters and the ac conduction mechanism.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the effect of Sulfurylation on the electrical properties of amorphus In4Se96−xSx (x = 0–30) chalcogenide glasses.
the dielectric properties of amorphic semiconductor and the results obtained are in good agreement with the theory of correlated barrier hopping.
the study of dielectric relaxation and ac conductivity mechanism of In4Se95S1 and In4Se94S2 amorphous chalcogenide semiconductor.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dielectric relaxation, ac conductivity and dc conductivity are strongly dependent upon the Sulfur content.
the dielectric and ac conduction behavior of amorphous In4Se96−xSx is explained by the CBH model.
the ac conductivity in amorphous In4Se96−xSx semiconductor is due to the CBH model and the dielectric dispersion is due to dipolar nature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the dielectric constant decreases with the increase in the concentration of sulfur, the ac conductivity is frequency and temperature dependent and obey power law, the dielectric loss is frequency and temperature independent and obey power law.
Sulfur concentration affects the dielectric properties of the In–S–Se glassy semiconductors.
Sulfur doping is a useful way to control the dielectric properties of the amorphous semiconductor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Sulfur doping can be a promising candidate for the improvement of the dielectric and electrical properties of In4Se3 semiconductor.
the addition of Sulfur to In4Se96 composition has a significant effect on the relaxation process.
the dielectric constant of the material decreases with increasing Sulfur concentration.
